prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, softly lit photograph of a young person seated at a school desk, focusing on their hands and torso. The subject wears a short-sleeved, dark, slightly shiny top with gathered sleeves, and their reddish-brown hair is visible but their face is out of frame, creating a sense of anonymity and introspection. One hand holds a yellow pencil poised above a classic black-and-white marbled composition notebook, which rests on the beige surface of the desk. The background is minimal and softly blurred, with a hint of a dark chair, emphasizing the subject and their quiet, contemplative action. The color palette is muted and natural, with gentle daylight casting soft shadows, evoking a calm, studious atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field and a slightly off-center framing, lending the image an intimate, cinematic quality reminiscent of coming-of-age films or editorial photography.
